entries.proposition: Figure 2 (hand reading): rs2222896-rs2548861 D' = 0.87 (normal) and 0.81 (dyslipidaemia), r2 = 0.35 and 0.22. The Discussion calls the LD between the two WWOX SNPs 'weak' on the basis of the 500 kb distance; by D' it is high and by r2 moderate-to-low. 'Weak' describes r2 only. The four-SNP matrix also shows D' of 0.34 to 0.79 between the WWOX and TUBB SNPs.

entries.proposition: Table 6 prints the unadjusted odds ratio of the rs2222896G-rs2548861T haplotype as 111.055 with a 95% CI of 7.818-15.633, which cannot contain its own point estimate; the geometric midpoint of the interval is 11.05, so the printed value carries a stray digit (INFERENCE from the arithmetic; the paper does not say). The adjusted odds ratio in the Results and Figure 4 is 15.08 (9.24-24.60). The haplotype frequencies are about 0.020 in the normal group and 0.190 in the dyslipidaemia group (36 of 1728 versus 430 of 2258 haplotypes; the units are haplotypes, two per person).

experimental_context.genotype: common SNPs rs2222896 and rs2548861 in WWOX (and two TUBB SNPs), not a WWOX perturbation

entries.proposition: Figure 4 (forest plots, hand reading): the rs2222896G-rs2548861T haplotype odds ratio is 15.08 (9.24-24.60) as a main effect and its interaction odds ratios with sex, smoking, BMI, age and FBS are 6.7 to 14.9 with very wide intervals (drinking spans 1 to about 40); the other three haplotypes show odds ratios 0.47 to 1.44. BMI above 24 and FBS 7.0 mmol/L or above are the consistent environmental terms (about 2.0 and 1.7-2.3). A haplotype of two common variants with an odds ratio of this size is outside what common variants usually give; the paper does not comment, and no replication cohort or phasing check is described.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4, forest plots of haplotype and environmental risk factors for dyslipidaemia and of haplotype-environment interactions, four haplotypes.

entries.proposition: Figure 1 (hand reading; A total cholesterol, B HDL-C, C LDL-C, D ApoA1, E ApoB, F ApoA1/ApoB, G triglyceride): in the normal group only WWOX rs2222896 shows marked differences (B, C, D); in the dyslipidaemia group rs3132584, rs2222896 and rs2548861 show them. The y-axis spans 0-6 to 0-8 mmol/L or g/L so the differences (about 0.1 unit) are not visible at the plotted scale and the panel carries no effect size; the effect sizes are in Tables 4 and 7 (about 0.1-0.2 per carrier). The analysis within the dyslipidaemia group compares lipids inside a group defined by lipid level (selection on the outcome).
